Private artwork JPEG decoders

TJpgDec R0.03, ChaN, 2021
Source: https://elm-chan.org/fsw/tjpgd/arc/tjpgd3.zip
Documentation: https://elm-chan.org/fsw/tjpgd/
Downloaded archive SHA256:
052fe3efbc9a8be29f31597ad009c5b51a4f6905878eb28569e0ab3d46d0c013
The copyright and permissive redistribution notice remain in tjpgd/tjpgd.c.
Configuration: RGB888, scaling enabled, FASTDECODE=1, table clipping enabled.
Local header changes: fixed-width stdint types on Windows too, and private
aurora_jd_prepare/aurora_jd_decomp names to avoid collision with LVGL's fork.
No managed dependency is modified. LVGL's fork removes the scaling loops;
enabling JD_USE_SCALE in that fork alone would produce incorrect pixels.
The caller selects 1, 1/2, 1/4 or 1/8 with the shorter decoded edge >=312.

stb_image v2.30, Sean Barrett and contributors
Source: https://github.com/nothings/stb/blob/master/stb_image.h
Unmodified downloaded header SHA256:
594c2fe35d49488b4382dbfaec8f98366defca819d916ac95becf3e75f4200b3
The complete dual MIT/public-domain license remains at the end of the header.
Built privately in player_artwork_decode.cpp: JPEG only, no stdio/HDR/linear
conversions/SIMD; unused public functions are static and discarded.
Local changes to the header only add STBI_AURORA_CONTINUE cancellation/yield
checks between JPEG MCU rows, progressive finalization rows, scans/headers,
and output conversion rows. jpeg_finish returns status so cancellation
unwinds through the existing cleanup. It does not change pixel algorithms.

The JPEG fallback has 4096 maximum dimensions, 4,194,304 maximum pixels and
13 MiB total live scratch-allocation budget (including allocation headers).
The encoded image is separately bounded to 2 MiB; final RGB565 is 194688 B.
On ESP32 scratch is explicitly allocated in PSRAM. A memory shortage rejects
the candidate and allows another embedded/folder candidate, without restart.
The peak is measured on host, not a prediction of device free heap.

The real regression is a baseline JPEG with Y/Cb/Cr sampling all 0x12.
TJpgDec and ESP-IDF 5.5.2 P4 hardware-JPEG parser reject this legal layout.
stb handles it and progressive JPEG; no image conversion on SD is required.
Synthetic JPEG fixtures reproduce the sampling layout independently.
No user music/cover file is included in these sources or tests.

Container limits: 1024 ID3 frames, 256 RIFF chunks/FLAC blocks, 32 ranked
candidate descriptors, 4096-byte APIC/PIC metadata probe, 2 MiB encoded image.
Ordinary ID3 tags can exceed 2 MiB because unrelated bytes are seeked over.
Only global ID3v2.2/v2.3 unsynchronisation still reads a <=2 MiB whole tag.
Compressed/encrypted ID3 frames and linked images are not fetched/decoded.
WAV ID3 after a large data chunk is located by seek, never by reading audio.
Native FLAC PICTURE is supported; MP4/M4A atoms are not parsed.

Format references:
https://id3.org/id3v2-00
https://id3.org/id3v2.3.0
https://id3.org/id3v2.4.0-frames
https://id3.org/id3v2.4.0-structure
https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9639.html#section-8.8
